items.source: Marker interface to describe configuration classes that ship Jackson modules that are supposed to be added to the Jackson ObjectMapper configured for EnableSpringDataWebSupport.
items.translation: 标记接口，用于描述那些随 Jackson 模块一起分发的配置类。这些模块旨在被添加到为 EnableSpringDataWebSupport 配置的 Jackson ObjectMapper 中。

items.source: since 4.0, in favor of SpringDataJackson3Configuration which uses Jackson 3.
items.translation: 自 4.0 版本起，推荐使用 SpringDataJackson3Configuration，该配置使用 Jackson 3。
